decision_label: LEARNED EXTRACTION PROMISING, BUT ADAPTATION NEEDED (provisional — primary listening evidence pending)

provisionality.reason: The brief makes human blind listening the primary decision evidence. The 36-item anonymized pack is built and ready (listening_pack/), but no listening pass exists yet. All conclusions above are from fixed-gain waveform diagnostics, pristine-reference coherence proxies, VAD nuisance proxies, and spectrogram inspection.
provisionality.finalize_by: Owner completes listening_pack/LISTENING_INSTRUCTIONS.md, then applies the A/C/D gates below.

primary_question.strongly_suppress_obvious_nontarget: NO — best system (CLAPSep) reaches ~9 dB relative music suppression and removes clear announcer speech (c5: 6.5 s -> 1.34 s VAD-active), but the 2:08-2:09 taiko system prompt and in-music NPC speech remain clearly present.
primary_question.preserve_authentic_interaction: YES (proxy level) — CLAPSep keeps click-band level within -0.1..-1.1 dB of raw on all 8 clips; relative transient emphasis +2.9..+5.2 dB. Perceptual naturalness awaits listening.
primary_question.materially_better_than_raw_baseline: NOT YET ESTABLISHED — attenuation is audible-but-partial; the listening pack exists precisely to answer this.

evidence_highlights.clapsep_selectivity_consistent: rel_click +2.9..+5.2 dB on every clip; rel_music -8.6..-9.3 dB on c2/c3/c6 (logs/09_diagnostics.json)
evidence_highlights.clear_speech_removal_c5: CLAPSep VAD speech-active 6.50 s -> 1.34 s (only event-level speech suppression observed in stage)
evidence_highlights.named_case_taiko_prompt: No system materially suppressed the prompt (CLAPSep/AudioSep ~9-11 dB relative attenuation; SoloAudio deletion+invention; specialist -3 dB)
evidence_highlights.audiosep_replicates_r2: uniform -4.4..-4.9 dB attenuated-copy on every clip
evidence_highlights.soloaudio_ood_failure: outputs -14..-90 dB; c6/c7 digital silence; invented blobs (generative, disclosed, judged on fidelity)
evidence_highlights.reference_cancellation_dead: waveform cancellation ceiling +0.41..+0.82 dB (phase-incoherent phone transfer; R1 ceiling 5.9% coherent share)
evidence_highlights.specialist_transparent_but_weak: <=0.8 dB overall change; VAD gate cannot see masked NPC speech

why_B_and_not_A_or_C.not_A: No proxy shows a *clearly better* overall tradeoff yet: suppression is partial (~9 dB), and the brief explicitly requires listening evidence for 'clearly better on multiple real challenge cases'.
why_B_and_not_A_or_C.not_C: CLAPSep shows genuine, repeatable source selectivity and event-level speech removal on c5 — 'no tested system provides a useful tradeoff' is not supported.
why_B_and_not_A_or_C.B_second_clause_reinterpreted: The observed failure mode is insufficient nuisance suppression with well-preserved targets (rather than unacceptable target loss); the adaptation implication is the same: weak supervision/fine-tuning on domain data is the next lever.

listening_gates.upgrade_to_A: On >= 3 of 8 clip groups the owner prefers a method item over raw AND rates interaction preservation >= raw AND hears audible nuisance reduction.
listening_gates.downgrade_to_C: On >= 6 of 8 clip groups no method item is preferred over raw.
listening_gates.keep_B: Anything in between; identify CLAPSep failure modes and proceed to the smallest practical fine-tuning/weak-supervision design using S0/S1a infrastructure.

next_action_if_B.owner: Complete the blind listening pass (listening_pack/), unseal listening_key.json, record ratings.
next_action_if_B.then: Design the smallest practical adaptation experiment: S1a's one-session capture provides exactly-matched target+nuisance pairs for supervised fine-tuning of the CLAPSep-class masker (bounded magnitude-mask representation already oracle-validated in S1a); no new model family needed.
next_action_if_B.blocked_prerequisites: SAM-Audio access (gated) remains worth retrying before any capture campaign — its text/span interface is the strongest untested fit for this problem.

explicitly_not_done: No model training or fine-tuning (Phase 1 frozen-inference respected)
